purpose: FROZEN, append-only pre-registration ledger for the Scientific Progress Dashboard's Dimension 3 (Narrow) and Dimension 4 (Decide). One entry per open scientific question; each question carries a set of rival hypotheses that were pre-registered BEFORE their discriminating experiment ran (design rule 3). The initial hypothesis set is the FROZEN denominator of the reduction ratio -- it must never be padded after the fact. The ONE sanctioned way it may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out (see the labelled_fanout_growth invariant), which preserves the registration-time denominator separately so the ratio is always reportable both ways.
authority: This file is a derive-only INPUT. It never mutates claims.yaml, closure weights, or claim status. It is the human-adjudicated ledger appended at the same governance moment as /failure-autopsy -> /governance. build_hypothesis_space.py joins it against the live autopsy/manifest/evidence data to DERIVE surviving counts, momentum classes, decision-readiness state, and the time series. Nothing here is scored by the closure pipeline.

invariants.elimination_bar: A hypothesis may carry resolution.state == 'eliminated' ONLY with an adjudicated weakens (or a confirmed fan-out discrimination), met_elimination_bar == true, control_passed == true, and non_degenerate == true (design rule 4). check_hypothesis_space_integrity.py enforces this.
invariants.frozen_initial_set: initial_frozen_count_at_registration is fixed at registration and NEVER changes. initial_frozen_count tracks the current enumerated set and may only exceed it via LABELLED fan-out growth (see labelled_fanout_growth). A hypothesis's pre_registered_utc must be <= the resolved_utc of its adjudicating run (pre-registration before the experiment, never retro-padding).
invariants.labelled_fanout_growth: An EXISTING, already-adjudicated question's hypothesis set may legitimately grow when a GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination portfolio enumerates new rival explanations as earlier axes are eliminated -- but ONLY when all three hold: (a) STRICT FORM OF INVARIANT 3 -- growth is legitimate for legs whose adjudicating run has NOT yet resolved; a leg added after its own evidence is already in clears ONLY on GIT-WITNESSED provenance, i.e. its pre_registration_source artifact (or its own registry entry) was durably committed BEFORE the run resolved. The self-reported pre_registered_utc alone is NOT sufficient -- it is written after the fact and is trivially back-datable, so an audit reading only this file can never detect back-dating. The witness makes the honest case self-clearing with no human adjudication and the dishonest case detectable, because a commit date cannot be manufactured. Legs with no git history at all (uncommitted, wholesale rewrite, git unavailable) report as a quiet 'unverifiable' state -- not a violation, but not evidence either; (b) the growth is recorded as a machine-readable entry in the question's fanout_growth_events[] naming the autopsy that opened the portfolio (fanout_source) and listing the added hids; (c) initial_frozen_count_at_registration is preserved separately so the reduction ratio can be reported BOTH ways. Growth satisfying (a)-(c) is ADVISORY (labelled fan-out), not a violation. Growth that is unaccounted, unlabelled, or retro-padded remains a REAL bucket-(b) violation. NOTE: a growing denominator is itself a scientific signal -- a campaign that keeps inventing new candidate explanations as it eliminates old ones is FAILING to converge. The dashboard must report surviving/original AND surviving/current so this stays visible rather than being laundered into an improved ratio. DESIGN NOTE -- alarm fatigue is itself a Goodhart vector: a warn-only flag that recurs every cycle with a plausible narrative attached gets accepted by default (exactly what happened when 'benign per invariant 6' was cited for growth invariant 6 did not cover). Legitimate cases MUST self-clear on verifiable provenance so that a raised flag stays rare enough to be worth reading; silence-plus-a-narrative must fail where a git witness would pass.
invariants.human_owns_decided: decision.decided is set ONLY by a human via decision.decision_log_ref; the dashboard may say 'decidable_now', never 'decided', without it.
invariants.non_contributory_unchanged: A run whose evidence_direction is inconclusive/non_contributory and which does NOT discriminate a pre-registered leg leaves the tree counts untouched (it still appears in the momentum feed).

axis_families._purpose: COARSE, HUMAN-OWNED taxonomy grouping per-leg `axis` labels into families, so build_hypothesis_space.py can distinguish SUCCESSIVE REFINEMENT (a campaign closes out one family and opens a fresh one -- leg count grows while understanding narrows) from CIRCLING (new legs re-enter a family that already has eliminated legs) and SCATTERING (legs spray across families with none ever closed). The bare `fanout_added > 0` proxy it replaces could not tell these apart.
axis_families._authority: This map is ARGUABLE and belongs to the human, not the script. build_hypothesis_space.py computes over it and never invents or infers a family. Disputing a row here is the correct way to dispute a convergence verdict.
axis_families._unclassified_policy: An axis absent from `map` is reported as `unclassified` and forces the question's convergence_class to `indeterminate` -- it NEVER silently defaults into a family. Extend the map when introducing a new axis label (see /failure-autopsy Step 9b).
axis_families._provenance_caveat: These family boundaries were drawn on 2026-07-18 AFTER the competence_floor campaign had run, by a session that had already formed a reading of that campaign's shape. Confirmation-by-construction is a live risk: the taxonomy could have been gerrymandered to produce the verdict its author expected. Two partial checks -- (i) the boundaries are drawn on intervention LOCUS (what layer of the system a hypothesis blames), which is independent of any one question's outcome; (ii) applied to competence_floor it yields a NON-flattering result, classifying the 769 fan-out's drive-schedule leg as re-entry into an already-swept family. A taxonomy that only ever confirms would not do that. Neither check is decisive; treat the verdict as a reading, not a measurement.

_family_glosses.constitution: what the agent is endowed with BEFORE learning starts (innate drives, seeded priors, substrate capacity)
_family_glosses.process: HOW learning or decision proceeds (algorithm, credit, curriculum, exploration, selection, drive schedules)
_family_glosses.representation: WHAT is encoded or perceivable (state representation, readouts, observability)
_family_glosses.world: the TASK the agent faces (environment dynamics, reward structure, evaluation regime)
_family_glosses.instrumentation: whether the effect is MEASURABLE at all (metric validity, credit horizon as a measurement question)

questions.title: Does the control plane carry two independent degrees of freedom, or collapse to one scalar?

hypotheses.label: score-bias and temperature are independent axes
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (i): the MECH-320 tonic_vigor score-bias axis and the MECH-313 noise_floor temperature axis route to distinct E3 softmax parameters and produce non-collinear behavioural effect vectors (rank 2)

resolution.basis: 777 narrowed nothing. Its self-routed collinearity label is an artifact: mean_sin_angle 0.530 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and C1 fell on seed-count (3/5 vs min 4) plus dispersion. The score axis's dependent variable (D_action_mass) was saturated at ceiling on seeds 11/29/37 and at floor on seed 23, so the axis had no headroom to express itself; the P0 authority gate passed only via a mean across seeds that masked two seeds individually below the effect floor. Control therefore NOT cleanly passed. Hypothesis stays alive pending V3-EXQ-777a.

hypotheses.label: tonic baseline and phasic transient are independent DOF on one readout
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii): the MECH-313 tonic noise_floor moves the sustained baseline entropy while the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst moves an event-locked transient on the same E3 temperature readout, with cross-legs ~0 (double dissociation)

resolution.basis: 779 narrowed nothing and its readiness was unmet (non_degenerate false). The substrate was NOT the problem: SD-069 was correctly wired (signal_source instantaneous_pe) and fired in every PHASIC-ON cell (burst_level_max 1.0, 5-22 event ticks). The failed phasic_fires_real_events precondition (5 vs 10) is a min across cells sourced entirely from seed 23/T1P1, which ran 19 of 900 budgeted steps. Hypothesis stays alive pending V3-EXQ-779a.

hypotheses.desc: the rival reading: apparent tonic/phasic and score/temperature distinctions are reparameterisations of one underlying control scalar, so no genuine second degree of freedom exists

resolution.basis: The rival hypothesis remains untested. 777 appeared to support it but did so via a saturated dependent variable, not via a fair test; that apparent support is withdrawn by this autopsy.

decision.decision_question: Does the REE control plane retain >=2 independent control degrees of freedom, or is it effectively one scalar?
decision.live_gate: V3-EXQ-777a and V3-EXQ-779a with sample-driven stopping, per-seed authority gating, and a saturation guard on the score axis's dependent variable
decision.distance_phrase: Two runs spent (777, 779), zero of three hypotheses eliminated. Both were sample-starved before they could discriminate; the space is unnarrowed.
decision.observation_bottleneck: Sample starvation: the shared 2x2 telemetry-probe template denominates its budget in episodes while its gates are denominated in selections/event-ticks, and an untrained agent in a hazard-terminating env yields 2-100% of budget depending on seed (40x spread, reproduced across both runs).

questions.title: Do the SD-068 consolidation-pipeline per-phase readouts measure content fidelity, or raw noise sensitivity?

hypotheses.label: the SWS denoising readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: sws_denoising_snr scores the preserved deviation-structure of injected clean prototypes, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance rather than raw noise sensitivity

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 1.0000 (sd 2.7e-8, 95% CI [0.99999997, 1.00000001]) on 8/8 seeds -- the zero-content null arm reproduces the injected arm's sigma-slope to eight decimal places. Structural, not statistical: noise_power is identical across arms at every sigma while signal_power is 5585.7 vs 0.0, so denoising_snr_db = 10*log10(signal/noise) has a sigma-slope driven entirely by log(noise_power) and the content term differentiates away. Readiness precondition met (injected slope 0.0665 >> 1e-06) and criteria_non_degenerate true, so the control discriminated cleanly.

hypotheses.label: the NREM transfer-fidelity readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: nrem_transfer_fidelity measures the fraction of the injected-content gap closed by the CrossModuleConsolidator pass, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 0.1445 (sd 0.00090, 95% CI [0.1438, 0.1451]), 0/8 seeds confounded, verdict stable, CI well below the 0.25 ceiling and not straddling it. The null arm's slope is ~14% of the injected arm's, so the readout is substantially content-contingent. Necessary-not-sufficient for SD-068's full 3-phase contract: this is the ONLY phase confirmed content-contingent.

hypotheses.label: the REM precision-calibration readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: rem_precision_error scores |running_variance_after - 1/target_clean| against an injected known target precision, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.basis: The run narrowed nothing on this leg. Per-seed null ratios are degenerate at BOTH rails: exactly 0.0 on 5/8 seeds (null calibration_error pinned at the constant 998.5009992509989 with target_clamped 1.0, giving an identically zero slope) and off-scale 1801-9143 on 3/8 (null precision reference collapsed onto the 1e-3 positivity floor, so 1/1e-3 dominates). mean 1911.6, sd 3306.1, 95% CI [-379, 4203], ceiling_inside_ci95 true, confound_verdict_stable false. The 5 apparently-unconfounded seeds are unconfounded only BY DEGENERACY -- a zero slope from a saturated constant is not evidence of content-contingency. Stays alive; the observation bottleneck is the clamp saturation, fanned out as H-rem-clamp-artifact / H-rem-genuinely-content-free.

hypotheses.label: the REM null degeneracy is a clamp artifact of the step=1.0 measurement choice
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The full-adoption step=1.0 linear interpolation drives calibration_error into its positivity floor / saturation constant, so the null arm cannot express a graded slope regardless of content-contingency

probe_amendments.retired_probe: re-run the rem leg over a step ladder (0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0) and read whether the null arm leaves the 998.5 constant and the 1e-3 floor. Declared null: if the null arm stays railed at every step, this leg is refuted.
probe_amendments.retired_reason: PROVABLY INERT -- would have returned this leg's own declared null BY CONSTRUCTION. ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py recalibrate_precision_to computes rv_after = (1-step)*rv_before + step*(1/(target+1e-6)), so (a) the max(1e-3, raw_target) positivity clamp is applied to corrupt_target UPSTREAM of step, making the clamp fraction and the null-series distinct-value count EXACTLY step-invariant, and (b) both arms' sigma-slopes carry the same linear factor step, which CANCELS in the reported ratio |null slope| / |injected slope|. Verified numerically over step in {0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0}: ratio identical to 12 significant figures (14569.1833719598-...602, float round-off only), clamp fraction and distinct-value count bit-identical. A positivity-floor ladder fails for the same reason: the null arm's reference is centred on ZERO, so it clamps on ~half the draws at ANY floor value. Running it would have written a false elimination into the frozen ledger rather than a measurement.
probe_amendments.replacement_probe: UNPAIRED-TARGET null. ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED points the recalibration at an INDEPENDENT positive target of the same magnitude class (log-normal, positive by construction), unpaired with the clean target the error is scored against -- the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, NO PRIOR PAIRING' analog, versus the zero-content null which removes the pairing AND pushes the parameterisation off a cliff. ARM_NULL_ZERO (the 778c null) is retained as a replication anchor.
probe_amendments.replacement_declared_null: if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too -- still clamping, still constant -- this leg is REFUTED and the measurement axis is eliminated from the question.

hypotheses.label: rem_generative_gain is a content-free transfer-function property
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The attenuating generative gain (0.149, 8/8) may be a property of the rollout transfer function rather than evidence that 'correction needs an intact seed' -- which would undercut the sd_068 doc's line-221 gloss without touching the attenuation finding itself

resolution.basis: Untested, but motivated by an observation in the 778c manifest that sits OUTSIDE the scored C1 criteria: on seed 42 the null arm's rem_generative_gain (0.182/0.184/0.188/0.209 across sigma) is close to the injected arm's (0.165/0.166/0.172/0.190) at rem_gen_content_scale 0.0. Probe: contrast generative gain at content_scale in {0.0, 0.5, 1.0} across seeds. Declared null: if gain scales monotonically with content scale, this leg is refuted and the doc's gloss stands.

decision.decision_question: Can the SD-068 harness's damage-tolerance staging order be read as functional damage tolerance at all, or only as noise sensitivity?
decision.live_gate: an /implement-substrate rebuild of sws_denoising_snr as a content-scored readout, plus the rem-leg H1/H2/H3 portfolio
decision.distance_phrase: One run spent (V3-EXQ-778c, n=8). Of three per-phase readouts, one eliminated as content-free (sws), one confirmed content-contingent (nrem), one unresolved by degeneracy (rem). The staging order cannot currently be read as functional damage tolerance.
decision.observation_bottleneck: Two of three per-phase readouts cannot express content-contingency: sws by construction (its content term differentiates out of a log-ratio), rem by clamp saturation at both rails. Only nrem is a working instrument.
